Book (+10 nm to Dream Lore and Divination Lore)
Divinatory apparatus either set of Tarot cards or crystal ball etc. (+10 nonmagical, bonus to Divinations) (GM choice)
Knows a secret about an important person in the local region
Knows a secret about a person of importance from beyond the local region
Divinatory apparatus: set of Tarot cards, crystal ball, etc. (+20 nonmagical, bonus to Divinations)
Access to library/collection of historical, divinatory, or astrological records
An astrological almanac covering one year

training-packages.name: School Master
training-packages.flavour-text: I am Master Kim of the Water Flowing School. My school teaches its students to use the energy of their attackers against them. Our teachings allow our students to gain inner calm and tranquility.
training-packages.description: The school master is a character who has spent many years learning a specific martial arts style. His training involved long hours of practice and conditioning, but now the character is an acknowledged master of his given martial arts style.

training-packages.name: Temple Monk
training-packages.flavour-text: Through strife and struggle, we gain knowledge and wisdom. I would be honored to test my skills against you. May my brothers give me guidance and strength.
training-packages.description: The temple monk is a character who has spent most of his life in the sheltered walls of a temple learning both his religious doctrines and his martial arts skills. The temple monk is often surprised by the corruption in the material world, but he is not defenseless thanks to his extensive training. A temple monk strives to renounce the material world and pursue only his spiritual development.

training-packages.name: Cut Purse
training-packages.description: A specialized type of thief, the Cut Purse works the streets. He is particularly adept at watching crowds and determining who should have the heaviest pockets.

training-packages.name: Duelist
training-packages.description: Where words leave off, swords pick up. Often disputes are settled in duels of honor. A duelist is a professional settler of such disputes. They can be hired to fight for lords, so the lord need not worry about his own safety. A duelist is adept at single combat, but not necessarily honorable combat. A duelist fights with honor only so long as he is sure he can win.

training-packages.name: Hermit
training-packages.flavour-text: The island was small and bare, but our chart noted a spring somewhere upon its crown. I went ashore with the crew, and found the spring easily. I also found, much to my astonishment, a bare hovel in the lee of the crest, and a very talkative old shrub of a man clad in sailor's garb and skins. I think he said his name was brother Codmi, though his speech was strange and old-fashioned and difficult to understand. He lives there alone, and functions as a kind of holy man and healer for the local fishermen. He keeps the spring clear for the sailors, and in return they bring him favors of food and supply....
training-packages.description: Retreating from civilization, the Hermit leads a solitary life of unremitting hardship. He makes his abode in the wastes, whether it be in the frozen mountains, under the blazing desert sun or on bleak island haunts. Distanced from the distractions of mundane life, the Hermit searches for spiritual or philosophical enlightenment.

specials.value: Bound by a vow (e.g., chastity, poverty etc)
One week’s worth of preserved foodstuffs
A fine gift from a passerby (worth 10d10 silver pieces)
Respected by a notable in the region (a noble, a wizard, etc.)

training-packages.name: Hoythij Râk
training-packages.description: The Unhomed are Dwarves who have left the cavernous homes of their fathers and gone wandering the world. Many young Dwarves (those less than a hundred years old) will follow this path if they have a taste for adventure and derring-do. Others, older and wiser, may have been one of the Ghârnurghir in younger years, or perhaps even a Dërnak, and come to have a wanderlust. Some are glory seekers, in pursuit of great treasures or feats of arms to win renown for their clan and race. Others feel dispossessed, have a gloom or taciturnity that even their fellows might view as weighty. Whatever their provenance, the Hoythij Râk may be encountered anywhere, at any time, and may be more dangerous than their warrior kin, for these Dwarves are unpredictable.

specials.value: High quality hylhe cloak (-10 to detect items within)

training-packages.name: Clerihew
training-packages.description: Among the Gnolls, music is an important part of an evening's rest. Rhymes and gently sung tales are heard often in the secrecy of Gnoll grottos, and rare indeed is the Gnoll who does not wish to have at least a bit of musical talent. The Clerihew are Gnollish bards.
notes: One of the spell lists must be used for entertainment

training-packages.name: Physician
training-packages.flavour-text: Rich? So I am. But mark you there is no shame in that. My prices are fair, and even low by the standards of the city. My patients pay me gladly! — I ask you, what is more valuable than one's health? Who will not pay handsomely for that single, priceless commodity? Go to, you can't criticize me for being rich. You might as well criticize the priests for being holy!
training-packages.description: A professional healer, highly trained in the diagnosis and treatment of injury and illness, the Physician will normally be bound by vows and duties towards the patients. Competence is not without its price, and only the wealthy will easily afford the services of the Physician. Some Physicians may be employed on a permanent basis by noble families becoming trusted confidants, while others will set up independent medical practices in the cities.

specials.value: Superior medical kit (+20 nm to First Aid)
Book (+10 nm to Diagnosis or First Aid)
Book (+10 nm to Second Aid or Surgery)
Friends with person of importance in local region
Owed a favour by person of importance in local region

training-packages.name: Executioner
training-packages.description: Even the most benevolent of rulers find that they must sometimes punish criminals, spies, or enemies with painful death. The Executioner is trained to do so with great efficiency. Executioners are trained in the art of torture and interrogation as well. In lands with public beheadings or hangings, the Executioner is often expected to make a grand display of torturing the prisoner for as long as possible. An Executioner with a brutal reputation can be a deterrent to criminals and spies by mere rumor alone.

training-packages.name: Shaguk Ru'Kleftäk-sher
training-packages.translation: Orcs who slay by blade and sorcery
training-packages.description: Though the Grey Orcs are not so physically powerful as their Greater kin, they have the strength of their Common cousins and the aggressiveness of any Orc. So it is that many who possess the ability to work spells may also wish to taste blood on their tusks and wet a blade. These Shaguk often pursue the profession of Shaguk Ru'Kleftäk-sher.

training-packages.name: Protégé
training-packages.flavour-text: When I first met master Grimaud and his pupil, I thought the boy was his son, or perhaps his younger brother; I would have guessed them twins if their ages had been commensurate. They wore the same style gown, cut their hair the same way, walked the same, spoke the same, held the same opinions, and even cast their spells in the same signal manner. I would have laughed (I assure you, I almost did) but the boy showed such formidable apprehension of his master's art as to be truly remarkable. He is truly gifted. The boy will prove another Grimaud before you know it. With luck he might even improve upon the original....
training-packages.description: The sole or star pupil of a learned spell user, the Protégé gains deep knowledge of a chosen area of magic, and a thorough understanding of the magical arts. Days spent in learning are repaid later with services rendered in assisting the mentor in his research and goals. Even if student surpasses master, or later rejects the ideals espoused by the mentor to follow another path, this long nurturing will shape and mold the Protégé's world-view and lifestyle for the rest of his career.
notes: The last Special 'benefit' should ALWAYS be taken.

Secret knowledge can range from knowledge of the powers/locations of an artifact/person/herb/etc., to a special spell researched by the mentor. The exact nature will depend on the focus of the mentor and the apprentice.

The powerful enemy(s) could be either an enemy of the mentor who is hostile to the apprentice (by association) or could be the mentor himself (if the apprentice has renounced the ideals that the mentor serves).
The equipment can be considered to be either gifts from the mentor or items acquired while performing tasks for the mentor.
The spell lists available should be chosen with GM consent. The Spell Mastery skills should be assigned to the lists learned with this package to represent the special focus on those spells.
TP Spell lists should usually be chosen from those normally available to the character. Access should not be given to Training Package Spell Lists which are attached to specific training packages.

specials.value: Friends with an ally of mentor
Book (+10 nm to a specific lore skill)

training-packages.name: Sage
training-packages.flavour-text: What? Speak up! ... Oh, sage. Yes that's me. Come in! I thought you said page. I was going to box you on the ear if you told me to run an errand. I'm too old for that sort of thing....
training-packages.description: The Sage is the consummate scholar, with an unparalleled enthusiasm for learning, who acquires and assimilates knowledge from many sources, and can, by dint of special training, discern much from a simple examination of an object, whether it be commonplace or magical. Many Sages dedicate their lives to the preservation of knowledge, and will be found copying manuscripts in libraries or recording scraps of knowledge for posterity in their journals.

Friends with a library curator or archivist

training-packages.name: Mariner
training-packages.flavour-text: When you live upon the sea, she is your everything. She is your mother; she is your foe. She will test you. She is your lover, and your nemesis. She is your goddess. Respect her and learn from her. Listen to her lessons, and remember them. Learning the ropes and ranks is another matter, and involves an entirely different kind of respect....
training-packages.description: While a common sailor may find himself at sea thanks to the blandishments and occasional force of the press-gang, the Mariner has chosen a life on the ocean wave. Years of hard training in the skills of seamanship and the arts of navigation transform youthful midshipmen into competent sailing masters, ship's mates and naval officers, who with luck, ability, favour and perhaps hard cash, will one day command their own ship.

training-packages.name: Romantic
training-packages.description: The art of seduction is a way of life to some individuals. A sweet phrase here, a gallant flourish there, the Romantic always makes the most of every situation. A Romantic may be overly competitive, overly optimistic, or just overly happy. In any event, the Romantic seeks to be the center of attention, especially with the opposite sex.

training-packages.name: Diplomat
training-packages.description: A diplomat is a person who has made it his job to negotiate and talk to various other people in positions of power and authority. He is usually well versed in more than one culture and has contacts in many cities.

training-packages.name: Architect
training-packages.description: The Architect is hired to build sturdy towers, castles, and keeps. Architects design and organize the building of all of their structures, normally without the aid of any drafting. Castles can be built without an architect, but when siege engines begin to close in, it's nice to know that the walls were built by the best.

training-packages.name: Herbalist
training-packages.description: A herbalist is a person who specializes in growing, preparing, and cultivating herbs. Very often, herbalists are found near urban areas (where demand for herbs is higher), though they also like the secluded nature of a more rural environment.

training-packages.name: Fortune Teller
training-packages.flavour-text: Some come out of desperation, and some out of hopelessness. Some come in greed or in lust or amibition. Others come to me on a whim, or upon the pricking of an intuition. They all claim to want the same thing: the knowledge of their future. But I know better than that. Of course I read them their fortunes, but that's seldom what they need. To give them what they truly need, you have to look deeper, and not into the future, but into their heart. You see, it's reading the customer that makes up the greatest part of my art; reading the bones is like breathing.
training-packages.description: Often self-taught, some Fortune tellers earn their living from reassuring the anxious about the future, to others it is a pastime with which to entertain their jaded friends. Success in prediction is as much due to an eloquent flow of words and understanding the querent as to any true ability.

A gift from a satisfied querent (worth 2d10 sp)
A gift from a satisfied querent (worth 5d10 sp)

Divinatory apparatus either set of Tarot cards, crystal ball etc, or an astrological almanac covering one year (GM choice)

training-packages.name: Dërnakwmün
training-packages.description: The Dërnakwmün are the priests of the Mountain Folk, the servitors of Dûntherradinbarak Mountainsbeard, Beard of the Earth. There are two different orders of Clerics, but the differences between the two are unclear, so much that the two seem often to run together.
notes: GM choice of which stat gain is available for a character

specials.value: Melee weapon (+5 non-magic) and Spell adder (+l)

training-packages.name: Crafter
training-packages.description: Many people are good with their hands and have the desire to create things. This training package represents all those people; from the blacksmith, to the coppersmith, to the jeweler.

training-packages.name: Protector
training-packages.flavour-text: Demons? You'd better let me handle this.
training-packages.description: Protectors are holy warriors that are sent into the world by their church with the specific mission of protecting people from one specific sort of creaturs (Demons, Elementals, etc.). They will hunt this type of creature down with a fanatical zeal, and stop at nothing to see these creatures erased from the land.
